interface.longDescription: Day Zero CTO helps early-stage technical leaders run the operating loop from a project-level knowledge wiki in Codex Desktop or Claude Code: context setup, hard decisions, weekly reviews, CEO updates, risk reviews, one-on-ones, CTO-level code review, spaced-repetition learning, durable HTML reports with dated index references, company-aware index context, collapsible Core Context/Reports/Help/Misc sections, help commands, cadence alerts, and a bookmarkable local index at knowledge/wiki/index.html.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me run Day Zero CTO for this startup.
